title: Normalize closeout Python EOF before seal review
failure_signature: Closeout staged diff hygiene reports a new blank line at EOF in generated Python files.
trigger_preconditions: Only additive owner-generated closeout Python files are named by the exact diff output.
candidate_workaround: Remove only the reported EOF blank lines, restage the same paths, and rerun the unchanged closeout gate.
recurrence_guard: Generate exactly one terminal newline and run diff hygiene before closeout-manifest materialization.
rollback: Restore the files from the staged index and retain the failure if any non-EOF content changes.
scope_boundary: Mechanical owner-file hygiene only; no evidence or authority promotion.
